title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


We are seeking a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer  to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.


What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)  and Pair Programming  as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot  on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React  on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.


Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP):  Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning:  Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization:  Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown ARC  system.
  • Allocations:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown KOALA  system.


Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.


Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.
  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by our partner.
  • Ability to learn and comply with all company policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
  • Ability to give direction and to receive, understand, and proactively respond to direction from leadership and other company personnel.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and interact effectively and appropriately with others.
  • Ability to maintain composure and work in a fast-paced environment while accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes.
  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating and preparing reports.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and monitor activities across business units.
  • Ability to complete or oversee the completion of assigned projects in a timely manner.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Role duration:  6 months with option to renew


Core hours:  9 am - 5 pm US Central Time Zone


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Local: Av. das Nações Unidas 14401 Conjunto 211 - Vila Gertrudes, SP

title: Subchefe de Máquinas
description:
Procurando um desafio?


Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore. Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.


A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.


Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time Offshore?


Pré-requisitos:

  • 1OM - III/2;
  • Experiência com embarcações do tipo PSV/ORSV/AHTS/RSV;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • CIR válida;
  • Todos os certificados 1031 e 1034 válidos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Fiscalizar diariamente as sondagens dos tanques de água, óleo e lastro;
  • Fiscalizar o recebimento de água, óleo combustível, óleo lubrificante, material permanente e de consumo, sempre que o Chefe de Máquinas determinar;
  • Encarregar-se do adestramento dos tripulantes de máquinas, deixá-los a par das Normas e Instruções Técnicas da embarcação e da Empresa.
  • Fazer a distribuição dos serviços da seção de máquinas, de acordo com os detalhes organizados pelo chefe de Máquinas, fiscalizar e executar o que lhe competir;
  • Distribuir e fiscalizar as quantidades do material saído dos paióis para o serviço diário, bem como o seu recolhimento;
  • Responsabilizar-se pelo material que ficar sob sua guarda assinar a respectiva cautela, Escriturar todos os serviços de manutenção, prevenção, correção e classificação contínuas, ocorridas durante o seu serviço.


Benefícios BRAM Offshore:

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco - Acomodação Quarto (coparticipação de 20% para consulta e exames simples);
  • Dental Bradesco - (com opção de Upgrade);
  • Alelo Alimentação;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada com Match de 5% da empresa;
  • Ajuda Locomoção;
  • Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores;
  • Benefício de Academias e Plataforma de Incentivo a rotina saudável.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Armazém
description:
Estamos buscando uma pessoa Supervisora Armazém que será responsável pelo planejamento junto as suas equipes que estão sob sua gestão nas operações de armazéns, visando garantir o bom andamento dos processos, sempre no desenvolvimento de estratégias para um melhor resultado a organização, dando apoio por todas as operações de Importação e Exportação do armazém, coordenando o departamento de operações, planejando, organizando e controlando as atividades e suas execuções.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Aqui na Santos Brasil você irá:

- Assegurar o depósito de todas as cargas armazenadas (Armazém) garantindo a integridade física;

- Direcionar e assegurar a motivação da equipe através da adequada gestão do capital humano, aplicando os conceitos e utilizando ferramentas disponibilizadas pela área de Gente e Gestão e outras quando necessário, visando o aprimoramento e desenvolvimento de potencial humano sob sua responsabilidade;

- Executar outras tarefas de cunho Operacional, Administrativo e Órgãos Anuentes;

- Garantir o atendimento aos clientes e fiscalização da alfândega e órgãos anuentes;

- Monitorar e ter foco no resultado da empresa, redução dos custos e na melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos;

- Orientar as equipes em assuntos relacionados as dúvidas, reclamações, solicitações de clientes, emissão de documentos e relatórios para clientes;

- Prestar rígida observância às normas e procedimentos de qualidade, segurança, saúde, meio ambiente, responsabilidade social e sustentabilidade da empresa, conforme compromisso com a Política Integrada, e de acordo com o Código de Conduta da empresa;

- Supervisionar o setor em assuntos relacionados a programação de férias, treinamentos obrigatórios, controle de horas extras e disposição de funcionários;

- Supervisionar as atividades de estoque: inventários cíclicos, semanais, mensais e anuais;

- Supervisionar atividades exercidas pelo setor de planejamento logístico;

- Supervisionar processos operacionais, analisando e monitorando o desempenho das operações de armazenagem e níveis de serviços contratados por clientes, analisar os desvios dos custos variáveis e fixos do setor coordenado.;

- Supervisionar as atividades do grupo de operação de armazém.


REQUISITOS:

Para ter sucesso nessa posição é fundamental que você tenha:

- Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior e ou áreas correlatas;

- Pós-graduação é desejável;

- Experiência em terminais alfandegados | Logística Aduaneira;

-Desejável experiência com sistemas de gestão de qualidade;

- Pacote Office avançado, principalmente Excel;

- Desejável conhecimento em Power BI (Qlik Sense)

- Inglês avançado para comunicação verbal;

- Domínio com LCL, NVOCC e carga fracionada.

- Análise de KPI’s de performance;

- Gestão de pessoas, com aplicação de metodologias de desenvolvimento de competências técnicas e comportamentais, trabalho em equipe, comunicação assertiva, relacionamento interpessoal sólido;

We are looking for a Sales Executive with a result-oriented mindset to join our local Sales operations within our Latin America Hub. You will be presenting and offering our global market leader WERUM PAS-X MES/EBR solution suite. You will work close to global and local Life Sciences Industries, acting as an Account Manager for customers and as a main commercial contact for new leads and prospects. Among others, your main responsibilities include:

  • Meet with Clients to present the entire product portfolio of Körber Pharma Software and to communicate our solution value clearly and effectively to business and technical audiences.
  • Possess the business ability to influence and gain customer alignment at all levels within customer organizations.
  • Create and quantify value for our customers by mapping their requirements against the capability of our products.
  • Assume responsibility for dedicated accounts to retain and grow Körber Pharma Software’s market share with existing customers.
  • Develop and implement account strategies for your accounts, growing revenue across multiple business types.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the client’s business, industry trends, and market forces affecting their business and product needs. 
  • Demonstrate technical products where required to win customer confidence.
  • Maintain customer information, account mapping, key contacts, and opportunity information in our Salesforce CRM system.
  • Travel within Brazil and Latin America with occasional travel to other Körber Pharma and Customer locations as required (approx. 50% of time).


Your profile

  • Experience with regulated environments (drug production & validation) and understanding of pharmaceutical processes and expectations of regulated companies.
  • Experience and knowledge of MES systems in Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology and similar) - Knowledge/Background of WERUM PAS-X is a plus.
  • Brazilian Portuguese native language fluency.
  • Proficiency in English and Spanish languages – professional conversational, reading and writing.
  • More than two (2) years’ experience in complex IT solutions sales. Thorough understanding of software project life cycles. Knowledge of key IT systems used in manufacturing.
  • Customer focus with superior listening skills and excellent written and verbal communication capability.
  • Energetic and enthusiastic personality.
  • Comfortable working at all levels of customer organization.
  • Action orientated and results driven.
  • Business acumen and empathy with customer needs and goals.
  • Excellent MS Office skills, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • A Bachelor of Science Degree in a Science or Business Administration Degree is required. Other Engineering qualifications will be considered.


Your working environment at Körber


Körber Business Area Pharma is the leading provider for MES software to the pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing industry. Our first-in-class WERUM PAS-X software offering allows our customers to control and record the making of life saving therapies to ensure the best possible business and patient outcomes. We are seeking talented individuals as we look to transform our business and products to meet the constantly shifting demands of the ongoing revolution in factory digitization and automation.


Your benefits

  • You will work in a modern work environment with an open culture towards improvements and new ideas.
  • You are part of a global operating company with a wide customer base and a growing business.
  • You profit from international cooperation within a group-expert network to implement corporate wide concepts.
  • You will work in a team who focuses on customer requirements.
  • Opportunities for personal development enabling attractive career paths as you work in interesting, challenging and varied projects.
  • You will have flexible working hours in the office or working from home.


Can you find yourself in this profile?


Then you are right at Körber. We are looking forward to getting to know you!

Você fará parte de um time de uma empresa do segmento que desenvolve tecnologia para o setor de seguros.


Atuação 100% remota | Ingles Fluente | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time

Senioridade em desenvolvimento Fullstack

Product thinking — importante discutir soluções e não apenas executar tarefas

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e contribuir com desenho arquitetural

Comunicação confortável em inglês

Experiência sólida com JavaScript + TypeScript

Domínio de React (principal linguagem no frontend)

Experiência em gerenciamento de chamadas a REST APIs

Conhecimento em testes unitários e de UI no frontend

Ferramentas de frontend: Eslint, Prettier, bundle optimization, Sonarcloud

Experiência sólida em Python (principal linguagem backend)

Vivência em AWS Cloud (Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Kafka/Queues)

Experiência em sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos

Experiência com React Native

Vivência com soluções de data/state management diferentes de Redux e Context API

Experiência com Java como linguagem complementar

Participar ativamente da discussão de soluções, aplicando product thinking e propondo alternativas técnicas viáveis

Contribuir para o desenho da arquitetura do novo produto, incluindo microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend com foco em qualidade, performance e testabilidade

Garantir a qualidade do código e das entregas, assumindo responsabilidade pelos testes automatizados (unitários, UI e integração)

Trabalhar de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time na definição de padrões e boas práticas

Otimizar e monitorar aplicações, aplicando práticas de event-driven architecture e escalabilidade em nuvem

Colaborar em um ambiente ágil, mantendo comunicação clara em inglês com o time e stakeholders

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Java Backend Developer

Location: Remote, Brazil Region – Resource will be supporting in PST working hours

Employment Type: Fulltime


Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Application Developer with a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Flyway, and SQL. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable, secure, and high-performance applications on the Microsoft Azure Cloud platform. This role requires hands-on experience with modern cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • 10+ years experience in Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications using Spring Boot and related frameworks.
  • Architect, implement, and deploy scalable applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Utilize Flyway for database version control and migration management.
  • Apply best practices in code quality, performance optimization, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, QA, and data engineering to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications using observability tools such as Splunk and New Relic.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions, design reviews, and technology selection processes.
  • Support business intelligence and analytics initiatives through high-quality data solutions.


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services, particularly Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Hands-on experience with Flyway for database migrations and version control.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.


Technical Skills:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA
  • Version Control & CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, JIRA
  • Databases: MongoDB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL
  • Development Tools: Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA
  • Monitoring Tools: Splunk, New Relic
  • Database Migration: Flyway
  • Testing Frameworks: JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber


Preferred Attributes:

  • Experience working in agile software development environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design principles.

title: SRE Sênior
description:
A Conquest One é uma empresa especializada em Staffing de Tecnologia da Informação, que trabalha há 25 anos oferecendo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis de outsourcing e hunting aos seus clientes, ajudando cada um deles nos seus desafios de forma única e exclusiva. Os nossos valores são cuidar de nossos profissionais, fomentar seu crescimento e inspirá-los a serem os melhores profissionais que podem ser. Somos uma empresa certificada pela GPTW como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar.

Procuramos consultores apaixonados por tecnologia e movidos por desafio, interessados no desafio abaixo:


Vaga: SRE (Perfil SysAdmin com experiência em AWS)


Descrição do Cargo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional SRE com perfil SysAdmin, altamente comprometido(a), organizado(a) e adaptável, que possua experiência em ambientes Cloud, especialmente AWS, e sólida base em Linux e automação. O candidato será responsável por coordenar atividades de recursos internos e terceiros, garantindo execução eficiente e cumprimento de prazos, além de atuar em ambientes críticos e transacionais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar e executar atividades de infraestrutura, envolvendo recursos internos e fornecedores externos.
  • Gerenciar ambientes Cloud, principalmente AWS, utilizando serviços como ECS, EKS, EC2, Lambda, ALB, Security Group, SQS, SNS, entre outros.
  • Implementar e manter processos de deploy de aplicações web.
  • Aplicar e gerenciar patches em servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Implementar e monitorar servidores, serviços, aplicações e microserviços, garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Atuar em Salas de Crise e ambientes transacionais críticos.
  • Colaborar em equipes que utilizam metodologias ágeis (SCRUM, Kanban).
  • Apoiar práticas DevOps, CI/CD e ferramentas como Jenkins e GitHub.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Linux e Shell Script.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação como Chef, Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, entre outras.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados RDS.
  • Vivência em monitoramento de infraestrutura com Zabbix, Nagios ou Dynatrace.
  • Experiência com containers, Kubernetes e microserviços.
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens de script e programação: Ruby, Python, JSON, Bash e PowerShell.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em segurança da informação ou certificações relacionadas.
  • Experiência com ambientes Função e Matera.

title: Executivo de Vendas - PAS-X MES
description:
Körber Pharma Software, Latin America

Executivo de Vendas - PAS-X MES

Körber is the home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do. Entrepreneurial spirit is our joint DNA. We develop future technologies and support talents to deploy their skills and reach their full potential. We combine our strong heritage with our understanding of local specifics and a global mindset to bring people together and create valuable solutions for our customers. We aim to be the first to do the right thing at the right time.


Join the home for entrepreneurs!


Your role in our team

We are looking for a Sales Executive with a result-oriented mindset to join our local Sales operations within our Latin America Hub. You will be presenting and offering our global market leader WERUM PAS-X MES/EBR solution suite. You will work close to global and local Life Sciences Industries, acting as an Account Manager for customers and as a main commercial contact for new leads and prospects. Among others, your main responsibilities include:

  • Meet with Clients to present the entire product portfolio of Körber Pharma Software and to communicate our solution value clearly and effectively to business and technical audiences.
  • Possess the business ability to influence and gain customer alignment at all levels within customer organizations.
  • Create and quantify value for our customers by mapping their requirements against the capability of our products.
  • Assume responsibility for dedicated accounts to retain and grow Körber Pharma Software’s market share with existing customers.
  • Develop and implement account strategies for your accounts, growing revenue across multiple business types.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the client’s business, industry trends, and market forces affecting their business and product needs. 
  • Demonstrate technical products where required to win customer confidence.
  • Maintain customer information, account mapping, key contacts, and opportunity information in our Salesforce CRM system.
  • Travel within Brazil and Latin America with occasional travel to other Körber Pharma and Customer locations as required (approx. 50% of time).


Your profile

  • Experience with regulated environments (drug production & validation) and understanding of pharmaceutical processes and expectations of regulated companies.
  • Experience and knowledge of MES systems in Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology and similar) - Knowledge/Background of WERUM PAS-X is a plus.
  • Brazilian Portuguese native language fluency.
  • Proficiency in English and Spanish languages – professional conversational, reading and writing.
  • More than two (2) years’ experience in complex IT solutions sales. Thorough understanding of software project life cycles. Knowledge of key IT systems used in manufacturing.
  • Customer focus with superior listening skills and excellent written and verbal communication capability.
  • Energetic and enthusiastic personality.
  • Comfortable working at all levels of customer organization.
  • Action orientated and results driven.
  • Business acumen and empathy with customer needs and goals.
  • Excellent MS Office skills, especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • A Bachelor of Science Degree in a Science or Business Administration Degree is required. Other Engineering qualifications will be considered.


Your working environment at Körber


Körber Business Area Pharma is the leading provider for MES software to the pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing industry. Our first-in-class WERUM PAS-X software offering allows our customers to control and record the making of life saving therapies to ensure the best possible business and patient outcomes. We are seeking talented individuals as we look to transform our business and products to meet the constantly shifting demands of the ongoing revolution in factory digitization and automation.


Your benefits

  • You will work in a modern work environment with an open culture towards improvements and new ideas.
  • You are part of a global operating company with a wide customer base and a growing business.
  • You profit from international cooperation within a group-expert network to implement corporate wide concepts.
  • You will work in a team who focuses on customer requirements.
  • Opportunities for personal development enabling attractive career paths as you work in interesting, challenging and varied projects.
  • You will have flexible working hours in the office or working from home.


Can you find yourself in this profile?


Then you are right at Körber. We are looking forward to getting to know you!

title: Operador de Caldeira
description:

Somos uma das maiores fabricantes de fitas adesivas do Brasil , com um catálogo que abrange 43 famílias de produtos e mais de 1.000 itens, atendendo a diversos mercados. Valorizamos relacionamentos, cultivamos valores e promovemos um ambiente saudável para crescer e inovar juntos.

Inclusão importa para a gente!

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.

  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.

  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:
